scientific_limitations_and_integrity.known_prior: Bell 2002 already proves the qualitative MSO zero–one law for these component-count growth conditions. No originality is claimed for that qualitative statement.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Broader quantitative partition results may subsume the speed. Complete texts for some relevant sources were inaccessible. Not independently audited or priority certified.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.method: Exact component multiset identity, lattice local-limit Fourier estimates, finite-round EF equivalence; finite checker supports but does not certify the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.novelty_claim: Explicit sharp uniform first-order rate n^{-1/(q+1)} and exact singleton-witness leading constant.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Fixed integer q>=1, uniformly sampled isomorphism classes of directed q-coloured star forests; fixed first-order sentence and fixed coefficient shift.

title: Sharp first-order convergence speed in unlabelled coloured star forests
